bug_semantics: RSA NOPAD encrypt/decrypt left-aligns TA-supplied input into a modulus-sized S-EL1 heap buffer with memcpy(buf + rsa_len - src_len, src, src_len) and no src_len <= rsa_len check. Both lengths are size_t; when a Trusted Application calls TEE_ALG_RSA_NOPAD with src_len > modulus size, the subtraction wraps and memcpy writes attacker-controlled bytes before the destination (heap underwrite of allocator metadata or adjacent core objects). The syscall in core/tee/tee_svc_cryp.c only checks access rights. The same sink exists in the mbedTLS software backend (sw_crypto_acipher_rsanopad_{en,de}crypt in lib/libmbedtls/core/rsa.c) and the NXP SE050 driver (encrypt_nopad/decrypt_nopad in core/drivers/crypto/se050/core/rsa.c). libtomcrypt is not this sink (rsa_exptmod rejects invalid size). CVE-2026-71969 is PUBLISHED (VulnCheck CNA; GHSA withdrawn_at null), affecting OP-TEE through 4.10.0.
flaw_origin: The first write of the unguarded left-align memcpy is f8907bbf8d02b725ccc386fb72a8bb6563fc06a3 (libmbedtls: support mbedtls acipher RSA function), which added lib/libmbedtls/core/rsa.c as a new file containing crypto_acipher_rsanopad_{en,de}crypt with memcpy(buf + rsa.len - src_len, src, src_len) and no bound. Immediate parent 000fae55c24d353127e0225836fae59bfa07beb2 has no that file and no rsa.len - src_len pattern. git log -L on the encrypt memcpy has only this commit. SE050 later copied the same pattern (a3ca687d03b4, 2020), dropped NOPAD in 8563cdc537a9, then restored it in 462192731c92 (2022); that restore is not the BIC. The 2026 fixes add src_len checks in the crypto-driver dispatch and at the SE050 memcpy sites.
